Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first turn by the Planner after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly inferred that the organization recognizing the title was the "World Boxing Hall of Fame." The search results from the WebSurfer clearly stated that Vince Phillips held the IBF title and mentioned "The Ring magazine" as the entity recognizing the upset, but never mentioned the World Boxing Hall of Fame. The Planner hallucinated this association without verifying it through the search results, leading to an incorrect intermediate conclusion before the correct "International Boxing Hall of Fame" was discovered in the subsequent step.
